mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 4.5%, SPX 20d returns are positive in < 60% of cases, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales signal robust consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days; the joint effect is stronger than either indicator alone.
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both rise, SPX 20d returns are negative in > 40% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (INDPRO growth < 1% annualized), a decline in industrial production signals economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO growth < 1% annualized, SPX 20d returns are positive in > 50% of cases, or the correlation between INDPRO growth and SPX returns is not negative (r > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Higher quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strong economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth is positive, SPX 60d returns are negative in > 40% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, SPX 20d returns are positive in > 50% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and decline in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, SPX 20d returns are negative in > 40% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST < 1000, SPX 5d returns are positive in > 50% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
